arm: boltz-2 affinity on one Blackhole p150a, tt-bio's shipped affinity settings

single.note: rep0 with the tt-metal kernel cache already warm from four probe runs on this card. runtime_s in tt-bio's results.json is 34.2 s, the structure leg only; the affinity leg is not accounted there.

affinity_leg_cost_model.what: Three probe points at 256 aa, main-leg sampling_steps pinned at 4 so only the affinity leg moves. Wall clock of the whole invocation; the affinity leg is the span from the structure leg's 'saving' line to the target's completion line.
affinity_leg_cost_model.reading: Flat in sampling_steps_affinity: 4 -> 44 is 200 extra step-executions and moves nothing outside the 221-244 s rep spread. ~8 s per ensemble member: 5 -> 1 samples drops the leg 210 -> 178 s. So ~170 s of the affinity leg is fixed per prediction, independent of both steps and ensemble size, and it is 52 % of the full-protocol 326.5 s invocation. Not attributed yet.
